news.headline: RECORD FLOOD — NWS Melbourne: St. Johns River near Cocoa at 18.0 ft at 5:15 AM Thu, above the flood of record (flood stage 16 ft), forecast to stay above record levels through late week/weekend; Flood Watch for Orange, Osceola, Seminole, Volusia, Brevard & most of east-central Florida through Fri Nov 20 7 PM — 3–6 in. of rain, isolated 8–12 in.; Flash Flood Warnings Thu morning for central Brevard incl. Melbourne, Titusville, Rockledge, Cocoa & Merritt Island

U.S. housing starts rose 9.9% in October to 1.309 million annual rate, beating forecasts — single-family starts up 4.0% to 864,000 — but building permits plunged 7.4% to 1.295 million, with single-family permits down 8.7% to 772,000, lowest since January 2023

Sarasota County drops fight over 864 homes near Celery Fields — commission voted 3-2 Nov 17 not to appeal a circuit court ruling requiring staff to process D.R. Horton's Live Local Act proposal for 864 homes on 51 acres; a mediated 126-home settlement remains on the table

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31 — permit application date governs which edition applies; Miami-Dade portal cutoff is 4 PM Dec 30, with new flood documentation and coastal corrosion rules

Copper plunged to a seven-month low Wed Nov 18 — LME copper settled at $12,471/ton and Comex front-month at $5.6595/lb, both lowest since April, amid strong dollar and AI-demand doubts; North American clean copper scrap fell 31¢/lb in the Nov 18 session

Regency Electric acquires Tekline Electrical Services of Chandler, AZ — expanding the Colorado commercial electrical contractor into Arizona; Tekline serves manufacturing, healthcare, education, hospitality and industrial markets

Fed minutes released Wed Nov 18 read hawkish — almost all October FOMC participants judged further rate hikes likely in months ahead to return inflation to 2%; October meeting held funds at 3.75–4.00% by 10–2 vote, next meeting Dec 8–9, with Gov. Waller calling for a 50 bp December move
Florida workers' comp: Commissioner Yaworsky approved NCCI's −7.4% average rate cut for new and renewal policies from Jan 1, 2027 — 11th straight year of reductions

NBA Wed: Heat 137, Bucks 130 — Giannis Antetokounmpo 27 pts, 13 reb, 9 ast in his first game vs. his former team, Miami's 6th straight win; 76ers 121, Magic 115 — Embiid 26 for Philadelphia, Franz Wagner 27 pts & 11 ast for Orlando

NFL Week 11 Sun Nov 22 — all Florida teams on the road: Buccaneers (3-6) at Lions 1 PM ET, Dolphins (1-8) at Bills 1 PM ET, Jaguars (7-2) at Giants 4:25 PM ET; Bucs QB Baker Mayfield missed practice Wed with a foot injury, Jaguars C Robert Hainsey out with a knee sprain
